name: clip1
text: Moonlit night, fast clouds racing across a dark sky above silhouetted low wooded hills, wind bending tall pine trees, a narrow unpaved dirt path with grass on both sides winding below, drifting mist, no roads with markings, no asphalt, no cars, no power lines, the camera moving forward quickly. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip3
text: A wide river at dawn with fast-flowing water and rolling mist, reeds bending in the wind, dark clouds moving quickly overhead and the first orange light on the horizon, the camera gliding low over the water. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip4
text: Heavy summer rain pouring on a dark bamboo forest at night, lightning flashing behind the trees, bamboo whipping in the wind, water splashing on stones, the camera pushing forward. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip5
